name: Masala Oats
steps: Chop the tomato into small pieces and measure the oats and peas. Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat, then add cumin and toast briefly until fragrant.
Add the tomato and peas and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring, until the tomato softens. If it catches on the base, loosen it with a splash from the measured water.
Pour in the remaining measured water and add turmeric and salt. Bring to a simmer, checking that the peas are becoming tender.
Add the oats gradually while stirring so they do not clump. Simmer for 5–8 minutes, stirring the base often, until the oats are soft and creamy; follow the packet timing for your oat type.
Add a little hot water if the mixture becomes too thick before the oats cook. Switch off the heat when it is slightly looser than desired, as it thickens while standing, and serve warm.
tips: Rolled oats take longer than instant oats; check the package.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
